name: Telecom Billing Dispute — XYZ Telecom
description: A fictional telecom billing complaint: wrong bill amount, requesting refund
greeting_text: Namaskar, aapka swagat hai XYZ Telecom ke customer care mein. Behtar seva ke liye yeh call record ki ja sakti hai.

root.prompt: Apni bhasha chunein. Hindi ke liye 1 dabaen, English ke liye 2 dabaen.

main_menu.prompt: Billing ki jaankari ke liye 1, naye connection ke liye 2, technical sahayata ke liye 3, baaki jaankari ke liye 0 dabaen.

billing_menu.prompt: Bill mein galti ki shikayat ke liye 1, refund ke liye 2, bill ki copy ke liye 3 dabaen.

agent_script.text: Namaskar, mera naam Priya hai. Main aapki kaise madad kar sakti hoon?
Haan, mujhe mera November ka bill zyada aaya hai. Mere plan mein sirf 499 rupaye tha, lekin 847 rupaye cut gaye hain.
Ji zaroor, main aapki madad karoogi. Kya aap apna registered mobile number bata sakte hain?

Theek hai, maine aapka account check kiya. Aapke bill mein 348 rupaye extra charge kiye gaye hain — yeh international roaming charges hain jo October mein lage the. Yeh November ke bill mein add hue hain.
Lekin maine koi international call nahi ki thi! Main India mein hi tha poore October mein.

Ji, main samajh sakti hoon. Main aapka complaint register kar rahi hoon. Aapka ticket number hai TKT-2026-78432. Yeh 348 rupaye ka refund aapko paanch kaam karne wale dinon mein aapke account mein credit kar diya jaega.
Theek hai, thank you. Aur yeh ticket number safe hai na?
Bilkul, ticket TKT-2026-78432 fully registered hai. Aapko SMS aur email dono mein confirmation milega. Koi aur sawaal?
Dhanyawad XYZ Telecom mein call karne ke liye. Aapka din shubh ho.
